# Vendored BesoGo

Unmodified snapshot of https://github.com/yewang/besogo for the goban_ui starting point.

- **SHA:** see `besogo/UPSTREAM_SHA`
- **License (code):** MIT, Ye Wang — `besogo/LICENSE`
- **Images:** CC, listed in `besogo/README.md` (go-assets, jgoboard, tozgrec)

Do not edit these files except to implement goban_ui issues (tether, delete-last, phone chrome). When pulling upstream, update `UPSTREAM_SHA` and note the merge in the PR.

Our demo loads scripts from `besogo/js/` and styles from `besogo/css/` — keep those paths stable or update `demo/index.html`.
